description: Source code for a .NET Windows Forms control 'PagePreview' that provides a PDF page preview with zoom and scroll features, using GDI+ graphics and PdfSharp library.

classes.name: PagePreview
classes.description: A Windows Forms UserControl for previewing PDF pages with zoom and scroll capabilities, rendering via PdfSharp's XGraphics.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the control.

methods.name: CalculatePreviewDimension
methods.description: Calculates the size and zoom level for the page preview based on control size and zoom settings.

methods.name: RenderPage
methods.description: Renders the PDF page onto a Graphics object, invoking a user-defined render action.

methods.name: PaintBackground
methods.description: Paints the background and border of the preview area.

methods.name: SetScrollBarRange
methods.description: Adjusts scrollbar ranges based on virtual canvas size.
